why: The kept slice sl-intent-to-design already holds fn-795, fn-818 and fn-798, the same three features the shaped slice needs, in the same build order, and each of them still serves bi-788. So nothing is pulled in and nothing is pushed out. The slice is not in progress, and it stays testable end to end: the product owner runs the three plays on the Claude Code command line.

decisions.question: Which slice serves business intent bi-788, and does it change?
decisions.answer: sl-intent-to-design serves bi-788 and stays as it is: no feature is pulled in and no feature is pushed out.
